summary: The product targets 15-35 year olds, using battery power with kinetic backup. It groups audio, visual, and other functions, ignoring tele-text. Design features corporate yellow color and slogan. The remote control has a curvy shape with plastic and rubber materials, jog dial, LCD display, and kinetic power generation. A design idea proposes a larger handheld device with a third grip, folding up existing grips, and bold colored buttons on a yellow background.
